source_text: Qui benedicunt eum hereditabunt terram; qui maledicunt exterminabuntur. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Those who bless him will inherit the land; those who curse will be wiped out. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Those blessed by him shall inherit the land, but those cursed by him shall be cut off >> Bible:Psalm 37:22]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
